lead: An item scanner keyed on blank lines merges the methods a file wrote with none between them.
body: `ctx.rs`'s last four `Ctx` methods run `}` straight into the next `///`, so a blank-line-only rule found no start after the first and filed all four into one slice — silently, because the partition still reconstructs. The second condition is *the previous line was the `}` that closed an item*, and it has to be `}` specifically: a multi-line `#[expect(…)]` also returns the depth to zero, at the `)]` one line above the item it is attached to.
